changes.name: 始祖の守護者ティラス

changes.name: Sin World
changes.evidence: Closes the last remaining declared item of C-S03-26 DRAW_REPLACEMENT (deferred since S03-U65). Real text (2011-02-24, Field Spell, within cutoff): instead of your normal draw during your Draw Phase, you can activate this: show your opponent 3 "Sin" cards from your Deck, your opponent randomly picks 1, add that 1 to your hand, return the rest to the Deck. WORK_QUEUE's note that this "needs a new random-reveal-pick primitive" was stale, the same pattern already proven for 始祖の守護者ティラス (S03-U76): every needed piece already existed. duelRandomInt (engine/06_replay_rng_v41.js, precedent: v80DiscardRandom) provides the opponent's random pick; a resolution-time multi-select requestChoice with min=max=N (precedent: 酒呑童子, cards/C6_auto_cycle24.js) lets the controller choose which N (up to 3, or fewer if the Deck has fewer) "Sin" cards to reveal; fieldIgnition (precedent: 大樹海/血の代償) makes the ordinary Field-Spell placement-from-hand fully generic, needing no script logic of its own (cardActivationOnlyV32 skips condition()/resolve() entirely for that path). The one genuinely new piece: drawReplacementCandidatesS03 (engine/1V_draw_replacement_s03.js) only scanned P.mz and P.grave, never P.field -- extended it with a third branch for the field zone (same shape as the S03-U65 grave extension). Also fixed a hardcoded-elsewhere gotcha the same U65 extension had to fix once before: the 's03u33.draw-choice' resume handler in cards/H9_claude_s03_draw_replacement.js hardcoded its accepted zones to 'mz'/'grave' only, which would have silently rejected the new field-zone candidate and fallen back to a normal draw -- widened to also accept 'field'. New file cards/HL_claude_s03u77_sin_world.js. Test tools/test_s03_u77_sin_world.js: 12/0, real DUEL path throughout -- real hand activation placing it on the field with no chain effect resolving (cardActivationOnly), a real Draw Phase draw-replacement offer, a real 3-card reveal with a real random pick landing in hand and the other 2 staying in the Deck, the fewer-than-3-available edge case (min/max shrinks to match), zero-Sin-cards-in-Deck correctly not offering it at all, and a face-down Sin World correctly not offered either. Not fixed-list reachable (not part of any 1103_MAJOR_DECKS_v1 deck); no R1 sweep applies, per-card real-path test + Replay audit is this unit's evidence. This fully closes C-S03-26 DRAW_REPLACEMENT.

changes.name: ドラグニティアームズ－レヴァテイン
changes.evidence: A NOT_STARTED main-deck Dragunity monster found via priority #7 (auditing the fixed major-deck lists directly after two consecutive clean fresh-pair sweeps). Real text (2010-06-19, within cutoff): (1) banish 1 face-up monster you control equipped with a card named "Dragunity"; Special Summon this card from your hand or GY. (2) when Normal or Special Summoned, you can equip 1 Dragon-type monster from your GY (other than this card by name) onto this card as an Equip Card. (3) when this card is sent to the GY by an opponent's card effect, you can Special Summon 1 monster that was equipped to it. Every piece reuses existing primitives: summonProcedure with from:['hand','grave'] (already generically supported by pileDuelActionsV370, just never used by any card with a multi-zone array before); the exact grave-equip primitive already used by 3 other Dragunity Synchros in this codebase (cards/F9_astra_system01.js: as01Pool/API.equipFromGrave/graveEquipLegalV31, System v31 'Astra 01') with a custom any-Dragon-type predicate; and API.movedByOpponentEffect (precedent: 突風) for clause 3. New file cards/HM_claude_s03u79_dragunity_arms_levateinn.js. Building this surfaced and fixed two real, previously-undiscovered bugs: (a) a card-local bookkeeping field written via a raw property assignment instead of API.setCardFlag silently broke Replay (the write never got journaled, so a fresh replay never reproduced it) -- fixed by switching to API.setCardFlag, matching the established 'effect-processing state must be written via an Action' rule (engine/40_legal_script_engine.js comment, S03-U08); (b) a genuine, previously-undiscovered ENGINE_MISSING gap: P3 provenance's effect-context wrapper (p3BeginEffectContextV3/p3EndEffectContextV3, engine/12_provenance_v3.js) was never wired into the real DUEL-mode chain resolution path (resolveOnePreparedLinkV27, engine/30_processor_chain_battle.js) -- only a legacy/manual resolution path and test harnesses called it directly (cards/88_p3_provenance_recovery.js's own test uses a manual oppSend() wrapper, never exercising the real chain path) -- meaning API.movedByOpponentEffect/moveProvenance silently always returned false/null for any card destroyed via a real chain-resolved effect in actual play, for every one of the 11 P3-recovery cards plus 突風. Fixed generically by wrapping sc.resolve(ctx) in resolveOnePreparedLinkV27 with p3BeginEffectContextV3(link.player)/p3EndEffectContextV3() (try/finally) -- a minimal, shared fix benefiting every card using this primitive, not just this one. Test tools/test_s03_u79_dragunity_arms_levateinn.js: 18/0, real DUEL path throughout -- real setup reusing ドラグニティ－アキュリス's own S03-U43 mechanic to legitimately equip a Dragunity-named card onto a host, a real summonProcedure Special Summon from hand banishing that host as the real cost, a real clause-2 GY-equip trigger, a real clause-3 revive after a real opponent Trap (サンダー・ブレイク) destroys it, a real negative control confirming battle destruction does NOT trigger clause 3, and a real summonProcedure Special Summon from the GY (the card's other declared source zone). All segments Replay-audited clean. Not independently re-confirmed via a fresh R1 sweep of a specific fixed-list pair; the dedicated real-path test is this unit's evidence, and the engine fix's generic-ness was confirmed via the pre-existing test_p3_provenance_cards.js (60/0, no regression).

changes.name: ジュラック・ヴェルヒプト

Clause (2) reuses the shared a3PreDamageDestroy-shaped 'no damage calculation, destroy before damage step' pattern already used by 14 other cards in cards/A3_auto_cycle01.js (precedent: ズババナイト), written directly rather than via the factory so it could share one script registration with clause (1)'s own continuous effect. Test tools/test_s03_u80_jurrac_velophnyx.js: 9/0, real DUEL path throughout -- a real Synchro Summon (Level 1 Tuner + Level 4 non-Tuner Dinosaur) confirming real ATK/DEF become 1900 (the real total of the 2 real materials' original ATK, 200+1700) and the extended snapshot really records each material's atk; a real attack on a real face-down Defense Position monster destroying it with real no damage calculation (LP unchanged both sides); a real negative control confirming a face-up Defense Position monster is destroyed by normal real battle damage instead. All Replay-audited clean. Not independently re-confirmed via a fresh R1 sweep; the dedicated real-path test is this unit's evidence.

changes.name: BF－孤高のシルバー・ウィンド
changes.evidence: A NOT_STARTED main-deck BF Synchro monster found via priority #7, continuing S03-U79/U80's cross-reference pass. Real text (2009-07-18, within cutoff), DARK Winged Beast Synchro Effect Monster, Level 8 ('BF' Tuner + 2+ non-Tuner monsters): (1) when Synchro Summoned, can select up to 2 monsters on the field with DEF lower than this card's ATK and destroy them; the turn this effect is activated, you cannot conduct your Battle Phase. (2) once during the opponent's turn, as long as this card exists face-up, your 'BF'-named monsters are not destroyed by battle. Clause (1) reuses s03SynchroSelf (the established real-Synchro-self-summon check, cards/H1_claude_s03_dragunity.js), v380SelectUpTo (the shared 'select up to N' targeting helper, precedent: 氷帝メビウス), and temporaryFlags.noBattlePhase (precedent: 裁きの代行者 サターン, S03-U73). Clause (2) reuses System v21 destruction protection (sc.continuous.protectV21) but surfaced a real gap: perTurn tracks usage on the PROTECTED card, not the card GRANTING the protection, so a source meant to protect any one of several different monsters once per turn could not be expressed -- each target got its own independent counter. Fixed with a small, generic extension: protectV21 specs can now declare perTurnScope:'source' (engine/1K_destruction_protection_v21.js: resolveProtSpecV21 records the granting card, protectionRecordV21/applyDestructionProtectionV21 consult protCountCardV21 to decide which card's counter to check/consume) -- opt-in, so every existing protectV21 consumer keeps its default per-target behavior unchanged (confirmed via tools/test_destruction_protection_v21.js and tools/test_destruction_protection_cards.js, both still 0 FAIL). New file cards/HO_claude_s03u81_bf_silverwind.js. Test tools/test_s03_u81_bf_silverwind.js: 12/0, real DUEL path throughout -- a real Synchro Summon (Tuner + 2 real non-Tuner BF monsters) whose real on-summon trigger destroys exactly 2 of 3 real legal targets (deliberately excluding a naive self-target pick, since this card's own DEF is below its own ATK and is technically a legal target too) and really locks the Battle Phase (confirmed via the real nextPhaseIdV27 production function); a real BF monster surviving real battle destruction once during a real opponent turn, and a second real battle-destroy attempt against a different real BF monster in the SAME opponent turn correctly NOT protected (the new perTurnScope:'source' extension); a real negative control confirming a non-BF monster is never protected. All Replay-audited clean. Not independently re-confirmed via a fresh R1 sweep; the dedicated real-path test is this unit's evidence.

changes.name: A・O・J ディサイシブ・アームズ
changes.evidence: A NOT_STARTED main-deck Six Samurai Synchro monster found via priority #7, continuing S03-U79/U80/U81's cross-reference pass. Real text (2009-07-01, within cutoff), DARK Machine Synchro Effect Monster, Level 10 (Tuner + 2+ non-Tuner monsters, no archetype-name restriction): if the opponent controls a face-up LIGHT monster, once per turn activate 1 of 3 modes -- destroy 1 set opponent card / discard 1 card to destroy all opponent Spell-Trap / discard your entire hand to check the opponent's hand, send all LIGHT monsters among them to the GY, then inflict damage equal to their total ATK. Reuses the established P1.1 'choose 1 of N modes, then a mode-specific follow-up' pattern end to end (precedent: 竜の渓谷, cards/89_p11_activation_choice_recovery.js's own p11cards.mode/cost-commit/commit-targets registered handlers) and the direct-array-scan already established for マインドクラッシュ (cards/00_generic_core.js) to read the opponent's hand (this engine keeps full server-side state, so no separate 'reveal' primitive is needed). Building this surfaced a real, subtle framework-dispatch pitfall: the first draft declared the card via defineUnifiedCardV4 with a single effect entry and branched on ctx.v4EffectKey inside its resolve() to pick the mode -- but for defineUnifiedCardV4, the V4 framework's own auto-generated sc.resolve dispatcher uses ctx.v4EffectKey to select WHICH of the card's declared effect entries (by their own EFFECT_TYPE key) to invoke, not as free data a card script can repurpose for its own mode selection; since none of the entries' own keys matched the mode strings, the dispatcher silently invoked nothing on resolve. Fixed by declaring the card via plain defineScript instead (matching 竜の渓谷's own exact precedent shape), where ctx.v4EffectKey carries through as ordinary, unreserved context data safe to use for a card's own mode selection. New file cards/HP_claude_s03u82_aoj_decisive_armor.js. Test tools/test_s03_u82_aoj_decisive_armor.js: 13/0, real DUEL path throughout -- a real Synchro Summon (Tuner + 2 non-Tuner monsters, Level 10, no archetype restriction), a real mode-1 activation destroying a real set opponent card, a real mode-2 activation with a real 1-card discard cost destroying both real opponent Spell/Trap cards, a real mode-3 activation discarding the entire real hand as cost then really milling only the real LIGHT-attribute cards from the opponent's real hand (a real DARK card in the same hand stays untouched) and dealing real ATK-sum damage, and a real negative control confirming illegality without any real opponent LIGHT monster. All Replay-audited clean. Not independently re-confirmed via a fresh R1 sweep; the dedicated real-path test is this unit's evidence.

changes.name: ブラック・ホール

changes.name: 盗賊の七つ道具
changes.evidence: Priority #7's IMPLEMENTED-tier audit, continuing after S03-U85's 月の書: 盗賤の七つ道具 (Seven Tools of the Bandit), the highest-consumer-count main-deck IMPLEMENTED candidate remaining (qty=7 across jurrac/karakuri/tg_skill of the 13 fixed decks). Real text: 'When a Trap Card is activated: You can pay 1000 Life Points, then target that Trap Card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.' Reading the existing implementation (cards/20_control_counter.js) surfaced a real, previously-undiscovered ENGINE_MISSING bug shared with ナチュル・パルキオン (same file, same shape, same root cause): neither card ever read ctx.event (the S03-U18/C-S03-15 activation-response mechanism, engine/1P_activation_response_s03.js, already used by マジック・ジャマー and 20 other declared cards) -- both instead freely selected ANY Trap card sitting in the S/T zone as a manual target with no chain-response gating, meaning they were illegally activatable with no Trap Card activation actually in progress (confirmed via strictScriptLegalityV2 returning ok:true with no chain open at all). This bug class was outside the original C-S03-15 audit's scope (limited to scripts already referencing ctx.event/onActivateSuccess). changes.name: カラクリ解体新書
changes.evidence: Priority #7's IMPLEMENTED-tier audit, continuing after U101: カラクリ解体新書 (Karakuri Anatomy), qty=3, karakuri main deck. Real text (Japanese/OCG): each time a monster named 'Karakuri' has its battle position changed (no 'you control' restriction -- either player's), place 1 Karakuri Counter on this card (max 2); send this card from the field to the GY to draw 1 card per counter. The counter cap and the cross-player emission wiring (notifyKarakuriPositionChangeV350) were already correct. But building the real DUEL-path test surfaced a real, previously-undiscovered bug: cost() captured the counter count into a custom ctx.bookCount property and resolve() read it back the same way, but in the real activation pipeline (duelActivateFromZone -> chain add -> chain resolve) resolve() receives an INDEPENDENTLY RECONSTRUCTED ctx object, not the one cost() wrote to -- any custom ctx property set in cost() is silently lost by resolve() time. The real counters are also zone-local (stripped the instant the card leaves sz as the cost), so simply re-reading them in resolve() was not an option either -- the real draw was always 0 regardless of how many counters had accumulated. Real text: if in your GY, you can banish 1 other Plant monster from your GY to Special Summon this card, increasing its Level by the banished monster's Level; you can only use this effect of 'Spore' once per Duel. The GY-recursion Special Summon was already correct, but two real bugs were found: (1) the same ctx cost->resolve persistence bug as U102 (the Level increase never applied in real play, confirmed empirically); (2) the real text names the card explicitly in its once-per-duel restriction, which per this engine's own documented 1103-ruling convention (RULING_1103_PER_CARD_LIMIT, precedent: Rescue Rabbit) requires nameLimit:true to track the limit per player across all copies rather than per physical card instance -- missing nameLimit:true meant 2+ real copies could each independently use the effect once, a real rules violation. changes.name: 血の代償
changes.evidence: Priority #7's IMPLEMENTED-tier audit, continuing after U103: 血の代償 (Cost of the Blood), qty=3, tg_gadget main deck. Real text (this project's own carddata.json 'e' field): by paying 500 Life Points, Normal Summon 1 monster; this effect can only be activated during your own Main Phase and during the opponent's Battle Phase; unlimited as of the 1103/March-2011 format (no once-per-turn restriction). The existing implementation (cards/00_generic_core.js) had no timing restriction at all -- with no passive hooks and no explicit timing declaration, the generic scriptTimings() defaulted to always-legal, so the card could be activated during ANY phase of EITHER player's turn -- confirmed empirically illegal-but-accepted: the opponent's Main Phase, the controller's own Battle Phase, and the controller's own End Phase. Fixed by checking activePlayer/phase directly inside condition() (own-vs-opponent turn ownership can't be expressed via the generic per-card timing whitelist). A SECOND, separate real bug was also found -- resolve() special-summons the chosen hand monster with zero Tribute payment or check regardless of its real Level (confirmed empirically: a real Level-8 monster was summoned for free) -- but is deliberately OUT OF SCOPE for this unit (no existing precedent in this codebase for a script resolve() to reuse the real tribute-selection machinery; flagged as the top-priority next unit, S03-U105). changes.name: マインドクラッシュ

Test: ワイト declared → the opponent discards both ワイト; not in the hand → its controller discards 1 card at random (no choice).

changes.name: エネミーコントローラー

changes.name: 異次元からの帰還

The 2011 text has neither: 「このカードがフィールド上から墓地へ送られた時、自分のデッキから守備力1500以下のモンスター1体を手札に加える。」 Now forced, field → GY of this card only, on engine/1ZT. Test: destroyed by ブラック・ホール together with two クリッター — one simultaneous batch, all three forced triggers resolve; DEF 1500 offered, DEF 1600 not; discarded from the hand it does not trigger; Replay-audited.

changes.name: 薄幸の乙女
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードは表側攻撃表示で存在する限り戦闘によっては破壊されない。このカードが表側攻撃表示でフィールド上に存在する限り、このカードと戦闘を行ったモンスターは表示形式の変更と攻撃ができなくなる。 Before: no script; until S03-U158 the text fallback made it battle-indestructible in any position. Now: protectV21 in face-up Attack Position only; continuous cannotAttack / cannotChangePosition for the monsters it battled (battle record written by the ATTACK action, zone-local on both monsters). Test (real attacks and turns): not destroyed by ギガンテス in Attack Position (1500 damage still taken); in its controller's next turn ギガンテス cannot change position or attack while ゴブリン突撃部隊 (did not battle) can; in Defense Position it is destroyed.

changes.name: スカー・ウォリアー
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードがフィールド上に表側表示で存在する限り、相手は表側表示で存在する他の戦士族モンスターを攻撃対象に選択する事はできない。また、このカードは1ターンに1度だけ、戦闘では破壊されない。 Before: no script; until S03-U158 the text fallback made it always battle-indestructible. Now: continuous cannotBeAttackTarget (engine/1ZU, other face-up Warriors, current race) and protectV21 once per turn. Test: the other face-up Warrior is not in the target list and an attack request at it is refused; the Zombie and a face-down Warrior are targets; survives the 1st 青眼の白龍, destroyed by the 2nd; afterwards the Warrior is a target again.

changes.name: イレカエル
changes.evidence: Text (2011): 自分フィールド上に存在するモンスター1体を生け贄に捧げる。自分のデッキから「ガエル」と名のついたモンスター1体を選択し、自分フィールド上に特殊召喚する。このカードがフィールド上に存在する限り、「ガエル」と名のついたモンスターは戦闘によっては破壊されない。 Before: no script (the text fallback made イレカエル itself battle-indestructible until S03-U158). Now: ignition, Tribute as cost, the Deck examined at resolution (shared deck-trigger choice), 「ガエル」 = GROUP.GAERU (P4-v6, 10 cards); protectV21 for every 「ガエル」 on the field while face-up. Test: ワイト Tributed, only デスガエル offered (not 粋カエル / サシカエル), Special Summoned; 鬼ガエル survives, イレカエル itself does not, then 鬼ガエル does not; the opponent's 鬼ガエル is protected; a face-down イレカエル protects nothing.

changes.name: エレキーウィ
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードがフィールド上に表側表示で存在する限り、自分フィールド上に存在する「エレキ」と名のついたモンスターが攻撃する場合、攻撃モンスターは戦闘では破壊されない。 Before: ENGINE_GAP (override: no Watt metadata, no attacking-only battle protection). The P4 group WATT exists (24 cards); the battle-destruction check now passes battleRole to the v21 protection. Now: protectV21 for own 「エレキ」 monsters only when attacking. Test: エレキツツキ and エレキーウィ attack 青眼の白龍 and survive; an attacked エレキツツキ is destroyed.

changes.name: 万力魔神バイサー・デス
changes.evidence: Text (2011): ①:このカードの召喚に成功した場合、相手フィールドのモンスター1体を対象として発動する。発動後、3回目の自分スタンバイフェイズに対象のモンスターを破壊する。②:このカードの①の効果の対象のモンスターがフィールドに存在している限り、このカードは戦闘では破壊されない。 Before: no script. Now: forced Normal Summon trigger with a target; zone-local link marks on both monsters; a scheduled destruction at the 3rd own Standby Phase (turn T+6); protectV21 while the linked target is on the field. Test (processor turns): targets ゴブリン突撃部隊; not destroyed by ギガンテス in turn 6; the target survives turns 7 / 9 and is destroyed at turn 11's Standby Phase; in turn 12 バイサー・デス is destroyed by battle.

changes.name: マイン・モール
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードは1ターンに1度だけ、戦闘では破壊されない。このカードが獣族モンスターのシンクロ召喚の素材として墓地へ送られた場合、自分のデッキからカードを1枚ドローする。このカードは相手のカードの効果によってフィールド上から離れた場合、ゲームから除外される。 Before: ENGINE_GAP (banishWhenLeavesField was unconditional and could not check the cause; until S03-U158 the text fallback also made it always battle-indestructible). Now: engine banishWhenLeavesByOpponentEffectS03 from the move action's P3 stamp (FX_TO_GRAVE / FX_WIPE_ZONE / FX_BOUNCE / FX_RETURN_DECK; bounce and deck return are now stamped); forced draw trigger on the Beast Synchro material event; protectV21 once per turn. Test: legal Beast Synchro ナチュル・ビースト → draw 1; Warrior Synchro ゴヨウ・ガーディアン → no draw; survives the 1st battle, 2nd battle → GY; opponent's サンダー・ボルト → banished; opponent's 強制脱出装置 → banished; own ブラック・ホール → GY; opponent's ブラック・ホール → banished (ワイト to the GY).

changes.name: デュアル・サモナー
changes.evidence: Text (2011): 相手のエンドフェイズ時に1度だけ500ライフポイントを払って発動する事ができる。手札または自分フィールド上に表側表示で存在するデュアルモンスター1体を通常召喚する。また、このカードは1ターンに1度だけ、戦闘では破壊されない。 Before: ENGINE_GAP (reason: no Gemini mechanic — outdated since S03-U119). Now: offered at the opponent's End Phase (onEndPhase; represented as an optional effect of that event), 500 LP cost, a Normal Summon by the effect (prepaid: the player's own Normal Summon is not used) of a hand Gemini (Tributes chosen at resolution for Lv5+) or a Gemini Summon of a face-up one; protectV21 once per turn. Test: チューンド・マジシャン Gemini-Summoned (LP −500, own Normal Summon unused); デュアル・ランサー from the hand; ギガプラント with ワイト Tributed; not in its own End Phase; not offered with no Gemini; survives the 1st battle, destroyed by the 2nd.

changes.name: E・HERO テンペスター
changes.evidence: Text (2011): …このモンスターは融合召喚でしか特殊召喚できない。このカード以外の自分フィールド上のカード1枚を墓地に送り、自分フィールド上のモンスター1体を選択する。このカードがフィールド上に表側表示で存在する限り、選択したモンスターは戦闘によっては破壊されない。（ダメージ計算は適用する） Before: no script (the text fallback made it battle-indestructible until S03-U158). Now: ignition, cost another own card to the GY, target an own monster; zone-local links on both; protectV21 for linked own monsters while face-up; 融合召喚でしか特殊召喚できない from engine/1ZK. Test: ワイト sent, ゴブリン突撃部隊 linked; not destroyed by 青眼の白龍 next turn (700 damage taken); with テンペスター destroyed by サンダー・ボルト the monster is destroyed.

changes.name: デュアル・ソルジャー
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードは墓地またはフィールド上に表側表示で存在する場合、通常モンスターとして扱う。…再度召喚する事で、このカードは効果モンスター扱いとなり以下の効果を得る。●このカードは1ターンに1度だけ、戦闘では破壊されない。このカードが戦闘を行う場合、そのダメージ計算後に自分のデッキから「デュアル・ソルジャー」以外のレベル4以下のデュアルモンスター1体を自分フィールド上に特殊召喚する事ができる。 Before: a coarse AUTO_DECK_TABLE entry (ignition recruit from the field at will, no Gemini gating); until S03-U158 the text fallback made it always battle-indestructible. Now: defineGeminiS03; protectV21 once per turn while Gemini-Summoned; optional trigger after damage calculation of its battle, the Deck examined at resolution (Lv4-or-lower Gemini, not デュアル・ソルジャー). Test: Gemini Summoned, attacks ゴブリン突撃部隊 and survives, only デュアル・ランサー offered (not デュアル・ソルジャー / ヴァリュアブル・アーマー) and Special Summoned; not Gemini-Summoned: destroyed, no trigger.

changes.name: 幻獣サンダーペガス
changes.evidence: Text (2011): 相手モンスターの攻撃宣言時、墓地のこのカードをゲームから除外し、自分フィールド上の「幻獣」と名のついたモンスター1体を選択して発動できる。このターン、選択した自分のモンスターは戦闘では破壊されない。 Before: no script (the text fallback made it battle-indestructible on the field until S03-U158). Now: GY quick effect in the attack-declaration window (engine/1Y), banish itself as the cost, target a face-up 「幻獣」 (GROUP.PHANTOM_BEAST), a v21 protection grant until the end of the turn. Test: offered at 青眼の白龍's attack declaration, banished; 幻獣王ガゼル not destroyed by the attack nor by a 2nd attack that turn.

changes.name: D・ステープラン
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードはこのカードの表示形式によって以下の効果を得る。●攻撃表示:このカードがフィールド上に表側表示で存在する限り、相手は他のモンスターを攻撃対象に選択できない。このカードが戦闘によって破壊された場合、このカードを破壊したモンスターの攻撃力は300ポイントダウンする。●守備表示:このカードは戦闘では破壊されない。このカードが攻撃された場合、そのダメージ計算後に相手フィールド上に表側攻撃表示で存在するモンスター1体を選択して守備表示にし、このカードの表示形式を攻撃表示にする。 Before: no script (until S03-U158 the text fallback made it battle-indestructible in any position). Now: continuous cannotBeAttackTarget in Attack Position (engine/1ZU); a GY trigger when destroyed by battle in Attack Position (the destroyer −300 ATK); protectV21 in Defense Position; a trigger after damage calculation when attacked in Defense Position (target → Defense, itself → Attack). Test: only D・ステープラン is a target (not ワイト); destroyed by ゴブリン突撃部隊 → 2300 → 2000; in Defense Position ワイト is a target, it survives and swaps positions with ゴブリン突撃部隊; destroyed attacking ギガンテス → 1900 → 1600.

changes.name: オシャレオン
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードが自分フィールド上に表側攻撃表示で存在する限り、相手は「オシャレオン」以外のモンスターを攻撃対象に選択する事はできない。 このカードが戦闘によって破壊され墓地へ送られた時、自分のデッキから攻撃力500以下の爬虫類族モンスター1体を手札に加える事ができる。 Before: no script. Now: engine/1ZT battle trigger (ATK ≤ 500 Reptile search) + continuous cannotBeAttackTarget (engine/1ZU) while face-up in Attack Position. Test: only オシャレオン is a target (not ワイト); in Defense Position the restriction is off; destroyed by battle → only the ATK ≤ 500 Reptile offered and added.

changes.name: ジェイドナイト
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードがフィールド上に表側攻撃表示で存在する限り、自分フィールド上の攻撃力1200以下の機械族モンスターは罠カードの効果では破壊されない。 フィールド上に表側表示で存在するこのカードが戦闘によって破壊され墓地へ送られた時、デッキから機械族・光属性・レベル4のモンスター1体を手札に加える事ができる。 Before: a coarse AUTO_DECK_TABLE entry; no protection. Now: engine/1ZT battle trigger (face-up; Machine / LIGHT / Lv4 search) + protectV21 (effect, sourceKind 't') for own Machine monsters with ATK ≤ 1200 while face-up in Attack Position. Test: 聖なるバリア －ミラーフォース－ leaves ジェイドナイト and D・ビデオン, destroys X－ヘッド・キャノン; サンダー・ボルト (a Spell) destroys them; destroyed by battle → only D・ビデオン offered (not the Lv3 サイバー・ジラフ).

changes.name: バイオファルコン
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードがフィールド上に表側表示で存在する場合に自分フィールド上の機械族モンスターが戦闘によって破壊され墓地へ送られた時、デッキから攻撃力1000以下の機械族モンスター1体を手札に加える事ができる。 Before: a coarse AUTO_DECK_TABLE entry. Now: an optional trigger of this face-up card when another Machine its controller controlled is destroyed by battle; the Deck examined at resolution (ATK ≤ 1000 Machine). Test: D・ビデオン destroyed → only サイバー・ジラフ offered (not X－ヘッド・キャノン) and added; not for ワイト, nor for バイオファルコン itself.

changes.name: 機皇兵スキエル・アイン
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードの攻撃力は、このカード以外のフィールド上に表側表示で存在する「機皇」と名のついたモンスターの数×200ポイントアップする。 このカードが戦闘によって破壊され墓地へ送られた時、自分のデッキから「機皇兵」と名のついたモンスター1体を特殊召喚する事ができる。 Before: a coarse AUTO_DECK_TABLE entry; no ATK gain. Now: engine/1ZT battle trigger (Special Summon a 「機皇兵」 monster, GROUP.MEKLORD_ARMY) + continuous ATK +200 per other face-up 「機皇」 monster (GROUP.MEKLORD). Test: 1200 → 1600 with own ワイゼル・アイン and the opponent's グランエル・アイン face-up (a face-down one not counted); destroyed by battle → only 機皇兵ワイゼル・アイン offered (not 機皇帝スキエル∞, not the Spell 鉄壁の機皇兵) and Special Summoned.

changes.name: ナチュル・チェリー
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードが相手によってフィールド上から墓地へ送られた場合、自分のデッキから「ナチュル・チェリー」を2体まで裏側守備表示で特殊召喚する事ができる。 Before: ENGINE_GAP (opponent-caused field-to-GY provenance and an up-to-two face-down summon were missing). Now: engine/1ZT field→GY trigger with extra = sent by the opponent (graveInfo.byPlayer for battle, P3 move provenance for effects), optional, up to 2 copies face-down Defense. Test: the opponent's サンダー・ボルト → 2 copies face-down Defense; own ブラック・ホール → no trigger; battle with the opponent's monster → offered.

changes.name: プチトマボー
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードが戦闘によって破壊され墓地へ送られた時、デッキから「トマボー」と名のついたモンスターを2体まで特殊召喚できる。 このターン、この効果で特殊召喚したモンスターはシンクロ素材にできない。 Before: no script. Now: engine/1ZT battle trigger, up to 2 「トマボー」 (GROUP.TOMABO, P4-v7) with the zone-local mark noSynchroMaterialTurnS03 read by the Synchro material candidates. Test: only トマボー / プチトマボー offered and both summoned; marked this turn and not Synchro material candidates.

changes.name: 素早いムササビ
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このカードが戦闘によって破壊され墓地へ送られた時、相手ライフに500ポイントダメージを与える。 さらに自分のデッキから「素早いムササビ」を任意の数だけ相手フィールド上に表側攻撃表示で特殊召喚する事ができる。 このカードはアドバンス召喚のためにはリリースできない。 Before: no script. Now: engine/1ZT battle trigger, forced 500 damage (before) then any number of copies (min 0) to the opponent's field face-up Attack (spec.toOpponent); script noAdvanceTributeS03 read by tributeCandidates. Test: 500 damage, choice 0–2, 2 copies on the opponent's field; not a Tribute candidate.

changes.name: 威嚇する咆哮
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このターン相手は攻撃宣言をする事ができない。 Before: no script, and the Battle Phase had no Start Step response window. Now: a Normal Trap setting the opponent's turn-stamped flag noAttackDeclareS03, read by cannotAttackNow; engine/30 opens a POINT kind 'battleStart' when the Battle Phase begins. Test: player II enters the Battle Phase, the processor stops at the Start Step, player I activates the set 威嚇する咆哮; ゴブリン突撃部隊 cannot declare an attack and a request is refused (no damage); next turn it can attack again.

changes.name: 和睦の使者
changes.evidence: Text (2011): このターン、自分のモンスターは戦闘では破壊されず、自分が受ける戦闘ダメージは0になる。 Before: ENGINE_GAP (no turn-duration battle protection for a player's monsters, no battle-damage prevention for the controller). Now: a turn-stamped player flag noBattleDestroyS03 read by battleProof + a v18 LP rule (cause battle, prevent, this turn). Test: activated at player II's attack declaration; ワイト ×2 survive ゴブリン突撃部隊 / ギガンテス and player I's LP is unchanged; next turn ギガンテス destroys ワイト for 1600.

changes.name: ガチガチガンテツ
changes.evidence: Text (2011): フィールド上のこのカードが破壊される場合、代わりにこのカードのエクシーズ素材を1つ取り除く事ができる。このカードがフィールド上に表側表示で存在する限り、自分フィールド上のモンスターの攻撃力・守備力は、このカードのエクシーズ素材の数×200ポイントアップする。 Before: IMPLEMENTED (the ATK/DEF boost only; the substitute was not implemented and no dedicated test). Now: destroySubstituteS03 {kind:'detach'} on the common optional destruction-substitute mechanism (engine/1ZV): at the destruction its controller chooses 「身代わりを使う：素材…を取り除く」 per material or 「使わずに破壊する」 (not cancelable), nothing moves before the decision. Test: ブラック・ホール with ガンテツ (2 materials), ザンジ, カゲキ and the opponent's ギガンテス — only ガンテツ is asked, the chosen second material is removed and ガンテツ stays while every other monster is destroyed; two ガンテツ in one ブラック・ホール are asked one after the other and applied together; Replay audited. Negative control on U172: no choice opens.

changes.name: E・HERO エアー・ネオス
changes.evidence: Text (2011): 「E・HERO ネオス」＋「N・エア・ハミングバード」 / 自分フィールド上に存在する上記のカードをデッキに戻した場合のみ、融合デッキから特殊召喚が可能(「融合」魔法カードは必要としない)。 / 自分のライフポイントが相手のライフポイントよりも少ない場合、その数値だけこのカードの攻撃力がアップする。 / エンドフェイズ時にこのカードは融合デッキに戻る。 Before: no script (and no contact fusion in DUEL). Now: the contact-fusion procedure (engine/1ZW, from the EX Deck, materials returned to the Deck, summon negation window, properly summoned, not a Fusion Summon), a continuous ATK gain of the LP difference and a forced End Phase return to the EX Deck. Test: Player1 at 3000 LP vs 8000 — ネオス + エア・ハミングバード return to the Deck, エアー・ネオス 7500 ATK; it returns to the EX Deck in the End Phase; Replay audited. Negative control on U173: the procedure does not exist.

changes.name: E・HERO フレア・ネオス
changes.evidence: Text (2011): 「E・HERO ネオス」＋「N・フレア・スカラベ」 / 自分フィールド上の上記のカードをデッキに戻した場合のみ、エクストラデッキから特殊召喚できる(「融合」魔法カードは必要としない)。 / このカードの攻撃力は、フィールド上の魔法・罠カードの数×400ポイントアップする。 / また、エンドフェイズ時、このカードはエクストラデッキに戻る。 Before: no script. Now: the contact-fusion procedure (engine/1ZW), ATK +400 per card in both Spell & Trap Zones and Field Zones (set cards too), forced End Phase return (same effect entry as エアー・ネオス / グラン・ネオス, tested there). Test: summoned in Defense Position with 2 set own cards and 1 opponent's card → 3700 ATK; Replay audited.

changes.name: キメラテック・フォートレス・ドラゴン
changes.evidence: Text (2011 carddata): 「サイバー・ドラゴン」＋機械族モンスター1体以上 / 自分・相手フィールドの上記カードを墓地へ送った場合のみ、エクストラデッキから特殊召喚できる(「融合」は必要としない)。 / このカードは融合素材にできない。 / ①:このカードの元々の攻撃力は、このカードの融合素材としたモンスターの数×1000になる。 Before: IMPLEMENTED (the base ATK only, reachable through 超融合; its own procedure and 「融合素材にできない」 missing). Now: the contact procedure from both fields to the owners' GYs with the material set chosen by the player (face-down / opponent's marked), fusionMaterialCount from the procedure, cannotFusionMaterialS03 read by the fusion spells, 超融合 and contact fusion. Test: the opponent's サイバー・ドラゴン + own サイバー・ドラゴン + face-down メカ・ハンター → 3000 ATK; a キメラテック on the field is not a Machine material for another one; Replay audited.

changes.name: E・HERO アクア・ネオス
changes.evidence: Text (2011): 「E・HERO ネオス」＋「N・アクア・ドルフィン」 / 自分フィールド上の上記のカードをデッキに戻した場合のみ、エクストラデッキから特殊召喚できる(「融合」魔法カードは必要としない)。 / 1ターンに1度、手札を1枚捨てる事で、相手の手札をランダムに1枚選んで破壊する。 / また、エンドフェイズ時、このカードはエクストラデッキに戻る。 Before: no script. Now: contact fusion (engine/1ZW), 1-per-turn ignition — discard 1 (cost) → a random card of the opponent's hand destroyed (HAND_DESTROY_RANDOM_S03, the random index drawn inside the Action), forced End Phase return. Test: contact summon; discard → exactly one of the opponent's 3 hand cards destroyed (graveInfo byDestroy, from hand); second activation refused; back to the EX Deck in the End Phase; Replay audited. Negative control on U175: no script.

changes.name: E・HERO マリン・ネオス
changes.evidence: Text (2011): 「E・HERO ネオス」＋「N・マリン・ドルフィン」 / 自分フィールド上に存在する上記のカードをデッキに戻した場合のみ、融合デッキから特殊召喚が可能(「融合」魔法カードは必要としない)。 / 相手の手札1枚をランダムに選択し破壊する。 / この効果は1ターンに1度しか使用できない。 Before: no script. Now: contact fusion, 1-per-turn ignition without cost destroying a random opponent hand card; no End Phase return (the text has none). changes.name: E・HERO グロー・ネオス

restored_to_baseline.name: 真六武衆－シエン

S03-U143: ② 「フィールドのこのカードが戦闘・効果で破壊される場合、代わりに自分フィールドの「六武衆」モンスター1体を破壊できる」 is not implemented (the script's own auditNote: 「②六武衆による破壊代替は未自動化」).
